status_vocabulary.SOURCE_CONFIRMED: fact byte-pinned or verbatim-quoted from pinned published source (sequence pairs, Dataset S1)
status_vocabulary.INFERRED_CANDIDATE: digitized from a published bitmap figure with residual reading uncertainty; not machine-readable in the original source
status_vocabulary.UNKNOWN: not recoverable from any audited surface in this execution

conventions.helix_numbering: helices 0-17 per Suppl. Fig. S5a/b caption: 'Helices are numbered from 0 to 17 as a guide to better follow the positioning of the single-strand overhangs. The numbering of the helices is equivalent in both origami structures, please note how it is necessary to flip one of the two units upside down to be able to join the structures.'
conventions.diagram_ends: Suppl. Fig. S5b shows two diagrams: 'top' = upper axial end connections drawn with blue dashes; 'bottom' = lower axial end connections drawn with red dashes. The two diagrams are front views of the two axial ends; each object has 2 arms of an 18-helix bundle, and only front helices are drawn, so a drawn attachment may sit on a hidden back helix.
conventions.figure_markers: in the bitmap, arrowheads mark 3' termini and small squares mark 5' termini as drawn; the follower is drawn flipped upside down relative to the driver, so square/arrow placement on the follower side must not be over-interpreted geometrically
conventions.overhang_segments: 20-nt LNA-stripped reverse-complement segments from EX-PREP-S17-R3 recipe (docs/work/executions/EX-PREP-S17-R3/evidence/s17-r3-df-interface-recipe.json @ git 2cf8297f10ab5ec98b8c8023ff76b39d92ef398b); driver_segment == reverse_complement(follower_segment) machine-verified in R3
